title: Multipart upload defaults
text: The OpenAI-compatible API supports multipart file uploads. The default max_file_size is 10 MiB for each file. The default max_total_request_size is 50 MiB for the complete request. Administrators may lower these limits per deployment.

title: Contractor access playbook
text: Contractor access expires after 90 days by default. The sponsor must review the account before renewal. Emergency extensions require approval from Security and the owning manager.

title: Incident channel notes
text: For a severity-one incident, page the SRE on-call and open an incident room. Post status updates every 30 minutes until mitigation is complete.
